╭─ Ask ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ The service needs a datastore before the first release. Which one should the team provision first?         │
│                                                                                                            │
│ Datastore                                                                                                  │
│   ◉ Postgres: relational, JSONB support, the team already runs it in production and knows how to back it   │
│     up (recommended)                                                                                       │
│   ○ SQLite: embedded, zero-ops                                                                             │
│   ○ MongoDB: document store                                                                                │
│ ❯ ◉ Other: Cats                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                            │
│   Submit                                                                                                   │
